description: This file defines the class MidiOutputPortSelector, a subclass of MidiPortSelector, responsible for managing a MIDI output port selection interface in an Android application. It handles opening, closing, and connecting to MIDI output ports, and provides a MidiSender for sending MIDI messages through the selected port.

classes.name: MidiOutputPortSelector
classes.description: A class that manages the selection and connection of a MIDI output port in an Android environment, allowing sending MIDI messages through the selected port.

methods.name: MidiOutputPortSelector
methods.description: Constructor initializing the selector with MIDI manager, activity, and UI spinner ID, and specifying that it manages output ports.

methods.name: onPortSelected
methods.description: Handles the event of a port being selected, opens the device, and connects the output port to a dispatcher.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Disconnects and closes the currently open MIDI output port and device.

methods.name: getSender
methods.description: Returns a MidiSender that sends messages through the currently selected and connected MIDI output port.
